description:
Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider to segment the website 'https://books.toscrape.com/' into specific categories. 

STEPS:
1. Go to Configuration > Segments.
2. Create three segments with the following rules:
   - Name: 'Travel' for URLs containing 'travel_2'
   - Name: 'Mystery' for URLs containing 'mystery_3'
   - Name: 'Poetry' for URLs containing 'poetry_23'
3. Start the crawl for 'https://books.toscrape.com/'.
4. Wait for the crawl to complete.
5. Export the 'Internal - HTML' tab to a CSV file at '~/Documents/SEO/exports/segmented_crawl.csv'.
6. Create a summary text report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/segment_counts.txt' listing the number of pages found for each of the three segments.
